Type: compact two-seat loveseat
Use: seating, small spaces; living room, kids room, dorm, entryway, studio apartment
Style: modern, retro, minimalist
Materials: quilted fabric with square stitching, grey tubular metal sled base
Colors: bright sunny yellow, light grey
Shape: boxy low body, straight back and arms at one height, thin flat seat, tubular metal sled legs, small and lightweight
Feel: cheerful, playful, light, youthful
